text.en:
There is created the position of Deputy Commissioner of the Budget in the Budget Office who
shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines with the consent of the Commission on Appointments of
the National Assembly, with compensation at the rate of nine thousand pesos per annum. When the
Commissioner of the Budget is unable to perform his duties, or in case of a vacancy in the office, the Deputy
Commissioner of the Budget shall temporarily perform the functions of said office.

The amount necessary to cover the salary of the Deputy Commissioner of the Budget for the
fiscal years nineteen hundred and forty and nineteen hundred and forty-one shall be taken-from savings in the
appropriations authorized in the general appropriation acts-for the said fiscal years for the Office of the
President of the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, May 26, 1940.
